scenarios.name: Cancel removal of a model-state parameter column

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user adds d0 to the model-state table and sets Copy State d0 to 2 in while leaving the other members at 1 in
The MCAD Software has a model-state table containing parameter d0
the d0 values for Primary, Capture State, and Copy State are 1 in, 1 in, and 2 in respectively
the user selects d0 in the chosen parameters
transfers it out of the chosen parameters
d0 is absent from the chosen parameters and the grid
the user cancels and reopens the model-state table
d0 is present in the chosen parameters and the grid
the d0 values for Primary, Capture State, and Copy State are 1 in, 1 in, and 2 in respectively
